formal_results: Closed policy producer evaluates each of the three existing presentations and its native comparison to target from certified operands, a checked compiler guard and source-derived outgoing request
Full comparison filler and synchronized request are computed; no Body, Resolve, reader, arbitrary family or synchronization-path import constructor
Every actual compatible policy instance on certified generated operands matches a producer by explicit dependent Body path and full native Closure path
Matching retains the original synchronized tuple/path and actual operand histories rather than substituting reflexivity or fresh seeds
The target presentation is judgmentally a generated Fragment with a source-producer certificate; other presentations have retained native comparisons to that exact target
Generated comparison derivations recover both actual policy-output and target native closures
Both exact final routes of the existing forward d/d1/d2 diagram instantiate all three presentations and both stages in the same certified initial context

interface.controls: Mode, certified operand programs, proposition-valued compiler success guard, outgoing request derived at the computed source point, presentation tag and output/comparison stage

interface.iteration_boundary: This producer covers the bounded policy family on certified generated operands; it does not iterate arbitrary raw adapter outputs as new generated operands

Bind the higher-envelope producer outputs to that common context
